messages:
Priya K: Quick share — I put together a tiny set of one-line "goal cards" and short feedback prompts managers and ICs can copy into 1:1s, self-reviews, and peer asks. Trying to keep everything scannable for remote teams. Paste+use and LMK edits.

Ava L: Love this. Could you add a 3-line self-review template ICs can paste into the cycle form? Managers will appreciate concise bullets. :+1:

Priya K: Yep — included below. Core idea: 1) what I shipped & impact, 2) biggest lesson, 3) focus next quarter. Example included.

Rohan S: These look great. Can we also get a small manager prompt for 'promotion-readiness' that isn't long? Managers often get stuck on wording.

Priya K: Short manager promotion-readiness snippet (copyable):
```
Manager note — Promotion-readiness (copy):
- Current level stretch: consistently owning end-to-end delivery for projects X/Y.
- Evidence: led rollout of Z, reduced latency by 20%, mentored 2 ICs on architecture.
- Gap to close: broaden cross-team influence; more proactive roadmap ownership.
- Recommendation: Promote when sustained impact + one cross-team initiative delivered.
```

Morgan T: Can you add a tiny "risk/assumption" line for each goal? Helps with planning.

Priya K: Yup — every goal card has a Risks line. Example goal card (one-liner style):
```
Goal: Reduce inference p95 for text-gen v2 by 20% (prod traffic)
Success metric: p95 420ms -> 336ms with baseline QPS
Stretch metric: cost per 1M tokens -15%
Owner: Rohan S
Timeline: Q2 end
Risks/assumptions: quantization may regress quality; hardware availability for benchmarks
```

Ava L: Very helpful. For peer feedback, can we give a 3-bullet micro-prompt?

Priya K: Sure — peer feedback micro-prompt: 1) One thing they did well (specific example), 2) One area to improve (specific example), 3) One concrete suggestion/action. Example: "Ship cadence — did X; could be clearer in roadmap doc; suggest weekly sync with infra."

Rohan S: Also adding a one-sentence "alignment" check managers can use in 1:1s: "Are you still working on the right top-3 priorities? If no, what's blocking?" Simple and effective.

people-ops-bot: Heads-up — performance window opens May 2. Use these templates to speed up reviews. Link: internal://people-ops/templates/perf-quickcards

Priya K: Final bit — copy-pasteables for ICs self-review (3-line):
```
1) What I shipped & impact: Launched async KV cache, reduced cold-start latency by 35%, improved UX for customers.
2) What I learned: learned kernel tuning trade-offs; built confidence measuring regressions with canary traffic.
3) Next quarter focus: stabilize multi-tenant autoscaler and mentor one new hire on infra best practices.
```

Morgan T: I'll try these in my next 1:1s and report back. Thanks Priya! :rocket:

Ava L: Can you drop these into the People Ops templates page and share the link in #general when live? Small wins like this raise adoption a lot.

Priya K: Will do — I'll update internal doc and ping here when done. Thanks for the quick feedback!
